items.summary:
With temperatures falling into the mid to upper 30s, light winds,
dry air, and clear skies, patchy frost could develop overnight
into Friday morning. Frost is most likely in rural valleys and
sheltered hollows. Those with sensitive plants outdoors may want
to consider taking action to protect them.
